name: Utah 4-H
what_you_do: Join clubs, camps and hands-on projects in farming, science, leadership and healthy living. Sign up through your county 4-H program.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 5 to 18 in any Utah county. Find your county office to sign up.
pay_detail: A small yearly membership fee. The amount is not stated. Ask your county office.
how_to_apply: Use the Find your County Office link on the Utah 4-H site, then ask that office how to join. You enroll and sign up for state events through Zsuite.
notes: State events include Teen Summit, Teen Winter Retreat and Mock Legislature. Fees and dates differ by county and event. Ask your county office.
